item.name: War Hammer of Vili

ownerLore.text: Vili was a notorious dwarven schemer who lived between 295 - 378.

item.description: Vili was a notorious dwarven schemer who lived between 295 - 378. This war hammer was once found among the belongings of a man who had no memory of where he got it. It was carried by those sworn to protect something greater than themselves.

item.name: Withered Jacket
item.description: An ancient jacket, its surface worn smooth by centuries of unknown hands. Whatever it once guarded is long gone. The habit of guarding, however, remains. Someone clearly cared for the jacket. The deep bite marks around its edge suggest it was not entirely mutual.

item.name: The Wretched Amphora
item.description: Whoever last owned this amphora took great care of it. Whoever found it did not. The Wretched Amphora's name is carved into it in letters too small to have been written by human hands.

item.name: The Adze of Magnor

ownerLore.text: Magnor was a legendary dwarven settler who lived between 525 - 638.

item.description: Magnor was a legendary dwarven settler who lived between 525 - 638. The adze once belonged to a traveler who vanished without a trace. It was the only thing left behind. It is said the owner never let this adze out of his sight, not even in death.

merchantStock.name: Pelt Shield of Stogil

ownerLore.text: Stogil was a disreputable dwarven ranger who lived between 282 - 346.

merchantStock.description: Stogil was a disreputable dwarven ranger who lived between 282 - 346. Strange markings cover the pelt shield, in a script no scholar of this age can read. Reading it feels like remembering something that never happened to you. Something about it draws on your own vitality just to remain whole.

merchantStock.name: Scroll of Identification
merchantStock.description: Reveals the true name, effects and possible curse of one unidentified artifact.

merchantStock.name: Scroll of Homecoming
merchantStock.description: A magical passage back to the Temple, far from the dangers of the wilderness.

merchantStock.name: Scroll of Invisibility
merchantStock.description: A scroll that conceals you from ordinary sight for a limited time. True-sighted enemies may still detect you.

merchantStock.name: Scroll of Fireball
merchantStock.description: Aim within 6 visible tiles. A 5×5 blast without corners deals 10–50 damage per creature, including you, ignoring armor. Walls block fire. Preview then Cast; Cancel costs nothing.

merchantStock.name: Flint Stone
merchantStock.description: Reusable fire-lighting tool. Use an abandoned campfire to light it with brushwood.

merchantStock.name: Brushwood
merchantStock.description: Dry fuel for an abandoned campfire. One bundle burns for 12 turns. Carry up to five.
